title: Veterinary Technology
author: Dayone Koo
_comment: PROGRAM EVALUATION (evaluate-program skill). Subject is the PROGRAM (Foothill College x TOP 010210), not a job title. Destination SOCs DERIVED: crosswalk(010210) intersected with SECTORS['agwet'].socs minus ALL_OTHER/PROMOTION/EXPERIENCE_5YR = ['29-2056', '31-9096']. lede: This evaluation assembles labor-market supply and demand evidence for Foothill College's Veterinary Technology program (TOP 010210): regional demand for the occupations it leads to, its award and enrollment trends alongside other colleges offering the same program in the region, and how its courses align with the work of those occupations.
demand_note: Foothill's Veterinary Technology program leads to Veterinary Technologists and Technicians (SOC 29-2056) and Veterinary Assistants and Laboratory Animal Caretakers (SOC 31-9096) via the TOP–CIP–SOC crosswalk. [According to the Centers of Excellence](https://datastudio.google.com/u/0/reporting/5060057c-b9ba-4081-9ed7-83356eaa7061), these occupations have roughly 1,130 openings a year in the Bay Area.
alignment_note: The colleges offering TOP 010210 in the Bay Area. Each supports SOC 29-2056 and SOC 31-9096 through the same TOP–CIP–SOC crosswalk.
award_note: Awards conferred each year by each college's program. An empty cell means DataMart reported no data.
enrollment_note: Enrollment each term in each college's program. An empty cell means DataMart reported no data.

29-2056.title: Life Sciences Animal Technician - VMU

29-2056.description: Performs laboratory and clinical procedures for the diagnosis and treatment of animal disease — blood and tissue sampling, urinalysis, vaccine preparation, and sterile technique.

31-9096.description: Feeds, monitors, and provides routine and postoperative care for animals in hospitals, clinics, and research laboratories, maintaining sterile equipment and housing.
